title: Won't open Pandora's Box: Supreme Court on HP judge's challenge to Collegium recommendations
description: The Supreme Court on Monday declined to entertain a petition filed by a Himachal Pradesh judicial officer who sought the consideration of his name by the High Court Collegium for appointment as a High Court judge.Arvind Malhotra, a Principal Judge serving at a family court in Dharamshala had moved the top court last week after the Supreme Court Collegium's recent recommendation for the elevation of three judges to the Himachal Pradesh High Court.
